overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（9 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（1 篇）。方法上以随机过程、数值模拟为主。来源分布：OpenAlex（6 篇）、arXiv（6 篇）。

papers.title: Temporally Validated Models for Target “Tclin-likeness”
papers.venue: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Identifying which human proteins are likely to become validated drug targets remains a challenge in drug discovery. We build on the “Tclin” concept, which encompasses proteins for which at least one approved drug exerts its mode of action (MoA); these comprise only ∼3% of the human proteome. We developed disease-agnostic, knowledge-graph machine learning (KGML) models that estimate “Tclin-likeness”: how closely a non-Tclin protein resembles established MoA drug targets in knowledge-graph feature space. Single-class support vector machines (1SVM) and XGBoost classifiers were trained on Pharos data current as of December 2017, using static (Gene Ontology, Reactome, the Kyoto encyclopedia for genes and genomes, STRING, HPA) and dynamic (genotype-tissue expression, LINCS, DISEASES, cancer cell line encyclopedia) features. To prevent data leakage, 115 proteins that acquired Tclin status after January 2018 were withheld entirely from training. Sensitivity on this external set was 88%–95% across individual models. Because non-Tclin proteins are unlabeled rather than confirmed negatives, specificity and precision are reported as bounds: balanced accuracy is 54%–75% for individual models and 73.7% for the eight-model consensus, which flags 5019 non-Tclin proteins (27.4%). The 1SVM models also identified a set of 1290 consensus negatives for XGBoost training. Benchmarked against two KGML druggability models, DrugnomeAI and PINNED, a consensus of 1133 proteins emerged. The Tclin-like consensus recovered 145 of 181 non-Tclin proteins in Phase 1–3 clinical trials (80.1%) and 23 of 28 proteins that reached Tclin status in 2023–2025 (82.1%), each approximately 3-fold enriched over background; it is statistically indistinguishable from PINNED (McNemar p = 0.42) while flagging 40% fewer proteins and outperforms DrugnomeAI (p = 0.0015). The three-model consensus places the druggable genome between 1860 and 5745 genes. Tclin-likeness is a prior, not a proof of tractability: these features encode nothing about binding pockets, ligandability or therapeutic modality. The “Tclin-like” consensus score is best used as an independent filter alongside disease-specific evidence and modality-specific tractability assessment.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
在药物发现过程中，识别哪些人类蛋白质有可能成为有效的药物靶点仍然是一个挑战。我们基于“Tclin”概念进行研究，该概念涵盖了至少有一种已批准药物作用于其上的蛋白质；这些蛋白质仅占人类蛋白质组的约3%。我们开发了与疾病无关的知识图谱机器学习（KGML）模型，用于评估蛋白质的“Tclin相似性”，即非Tclin蛋白质在知识图谱特征空间中与已知药物靶点的相似程度。我们使用Pharos数据库中截至2017年12月的数据，训练了单类支持向量机（1SVM）和XGBoost分类器，这些数据包含了静态特征（如基因本体、Reactome、京都基因与基因组百科全书、STRING、HPA）和动态特征（如基因型-组织表达、LINCS、DISEASES、癌细胞系百科全书）。为防止数据泄露，2018年1月之后被纳入Tclin类别的115种蛋白质完全未被用于训练。在这些外部数据集上，各个模型的敏感性在88%至95%之间。由于非Tclin蛋白质属于未标记的样本而非经过验证的阴性样本，因此我们仅报告了模型的特异性和精确度范围：单个模型的平衡准确率为54%至75%，八模型共识模型的平衡准确率为73.7%，...。研究方法：机器学习、XGBoost。

papers.title: Carbon Content and Economic Value of “Lamtoro” Biomass for the Co-Firing Control Plant on Timor Island, Indonesia
papers.venue: Jurnal Manajemen Hutan Tropika (Journal of Tropical Forest Management)
papers.abstract: Timor Island has a good source of lamtoro (Leucaena leucocephala) energy forests. Although lamtoro has been used for the substitution of coal within the co-firing control plant on Timor Island, there is no empirical data on the carbon content, calorific, and economic values generated from the biomass. This study aims to investigate the potential for lamtoro woodlands to produce renewable biomass. The proximate, ultimate, and chlorine techniques have been used to analyze carbon content and calorific values. While the economic value added (EVA) tools of analysis have been used to analyze the economic value of biomass. The result of the study shows that the calorific value (HHV—higher heating value) of the coal and biomass blend with a proportion of 95%:5% is 4,342 kcal kg⁻¹, almost equivalent to the highest calorific value of coal. The commercialization of biomass created from lamtoro is financially viable, as evidenced by the company's financial performance. Analysis of the financial performance included in the biomass generation commerce showed that each kilogram of lamtoro biomass contributes IDR133.23 (18%) to the final product's value, indicating positive business prospects. Based on this result, the government should implement a policy to develop and maintain the existing forest as a source of bioenergy.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】帝汶岛拥有丰富的兰托罗（Leucaena leucocephala）能源林资源。尽管兰托罗已被用于替代煤炭，用于帝汶岛的混烧发电项目中，但目前尚缺乏关于其生物质碳含量、热值及经济价值的实证数据。本研究旨在探讨兰托罗林地生产可再生生物质的潜力。研究采用了 proximate（简单分析方法）、ultimate（复杂分析方法）及氯含量测定技术来分析碳含量和热值，并运用经济附加值（EVA）分析工具来评估生物质的经济价值。研究结果表明，当煤炭与兰托罗生物质按95%:5%的比例混合时，其混合燃料的热值（HHV，高热值）为4,342千卡/千克，几乎与煤炭的最高热值相当。从公司的财务表现来看，将兰托罗生物质商业化在经济效益上是可行的。对生物质发电业务财务绩效的分析显示，每千克兰托罗生物质能为最终产品的价值贡献133.23印度尼西亚盾（占18%），表明该业务具有良好的发展前景。基于这些研究结果，政府应制定政策，以保护和开发现有的森林资源，将其作为生物能源的来源。。

papers.title: A Hawkes Microfoundation for Multitype Inverse Gaussian Subordinators
papers.abstract: We provide an event-level Hawkes microfoundation for a multitype inverse-Gaussian stochastic clock. We show that the event counts and integrated intensities of nearly critical multivariate linear Hawkes processes converge jointly to a multivariate pure-jump subordinator when reproduction delays have finite mean and immigration is balanced so that rare large families remain visible. The dependence among the limiting coordinates is inherited from microscopic cross-excitation, and the limit admits a Brownian additive-field first-passage representation. We call this process the multitype inverse-Gaussian subordinator. Its diagonal case consists of independent classical inverse-Gaussian subordinators, with the univariate model as a further special case. The square-root specialization recovers the inverse-Gaussian clock obtained at the boundary of hyper-rough square-root models by Abi Jaber--Attal--Rosenbaum (\textit{Ann. Appl. Probab.} \textbf{36}(4): 3635--3660, 2026). Our cluster proof exposes the underlying mechanism: finite-variance near-critical branching creates rare but macroscopic families, while their internal timing disappears on the observation scale, so each family becomes a jump. We also clarify the relation with the multivariate Hawkes scaling theory of Xu (arXiv:2412.14459): its diagonal-atom condition yields the diagonal specialization, whereas the genuinely coupled limit requires a separate uniqueness argument. In addition, under a common tilted-stability condition, we replace the high-intensity assumption in that theory by a weaker accumulated-activity condition and provide the Riccati identification needed when the potential has an atom. We strengthen convergence of the count and compensator and extend the scalar conclusion to finite-variance age-dependent branching clusters.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们为一种多类型逆高斯随机过程提出了一个基于事件级别的Hawkes微观基础模型。研究表明，当复制延迟的均值有限且移民过程保持平衡（从而确保罕见的大型事件家族仍能被观察到时，这些多变量线性Hawkes过程的事件计数值及其积分强度会共同收敛至一个多变量纯跳跃子过程。这些极限坐标之间的依赖性源自微观层面的交叉激发效应，且该极限过程具有布朗加性场首次通过（Brownian additive-field first-pass）的数学表征。我们将这种过程称为“多类型逆高斯子过程”（multitype inverse-Gaussian subordinator）。其特殊情况为对角线形式，即由多个独立的经典逆高斯子过程构成；而单变量模型则是该过程的另一个特例。当分支过程具有平方根特性时，该模型可退化为Abi Jaber、Attal和Rosenbaum在《应用概率年刊》（Ann. Appl. Probab. 36(4): 3635–3660, 2026）中提出的逆高斯时钟模型。我们的证明揭示了其背后的机制：接近临界状态的分支过程会产生罕见但宏观可见的事件家族，而这些家族在观测尺度上的内部时间结构会...。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Validity Without Ground Truth: What Stated-Preference Economics Offers the Evaluation of Language Models
papers.abstract: Many of the questions now put to large language models have no correct answer to score against: what a policy is worth, which option a user should choose, how to weigh competing values. Stated-preference economics has faced this problem for decades. It judges survey responses without knowing the true value, through a framework of validity and related concepts: content, construct, and criterion validity, reliability, incentive compatibility, and consequentiality. We argue that this framework is a general method for evaluating language models, and we set out what each concept means for LLM evaluation. We demonstrate the approach using a published water-quality stated preference economic valuation survey (Vossler et al. 2023) administered to six models. In this economic application, the validity tests take the form of predictions from economic theory: demand should slope down, and willingness to pay should respond to the scope of the good and to income. The tests separate the models sharply. Two older models fail the most basic test at a household income level of \$75,000, and the two newest pass every test of theoretical validity we can score, but diverge on convergent validity. Passing validity tests shows that a model's answers are coherent, not that they are correct.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】目前向大型语言模型提出的许多问题都没有明确的正确答案可供评估：某种政策的价值如何、用户应选择哪个选项、如何权衡相互冲突的价值观等。表述偏好经济学（Stated-Preference Economics）多年来一直在研究这一问题。该理论在不了解真实价值的情况下，通过一系列有效性概念及相关标准来评估调查结果，包括内容有效性、结构有效性和标准有效性、可靠性、激励相容性以及后果性等。我们认为这一框架是一种通用的方法，可用于评估语言模型的表现，并详细阐述了每个概念在语言模型评估中的具体含义。我们通过一项已发表的水质表述偏好经济评估调查（Vossler等人，2023年）来验证这一方法，该调查针对六个不同的语言模型进行了测试。在这一经济应用场景中，有效性测试基于经济理论的预测结果：需求量应随价格下降而减少，支付意愿应受到商品范围和收入水平的影响。测试结果明显区分了不同模型的表现：两个较旧的语言模型在家庭收入为75,000美元时未能通过最基本的测试；而两个最新的模型则通过了我们能够评估的所有理论有效性测试，但在一致性有效性方面存在差异。通过有效性测试仅能说明模型的回答具有连贯性，并不能证明其答案...。研究方法：大语言模型、调查数据。

papers.title: Between fatwa and FOMO: How Muslim millennials reconcile faith with crypto asset investment
papers.abstract: This exploratory phenomenological study aims to analyze how selected Muslim millennial investors in East Java, Indonesia, negotiate the psychological pressure of FOMO (Fear of Missing Out) and reconcile their faith with participation in the volatile crypto market, despite the official fatwas from the Indonesian Ulema Council (MUI) and PWNU East Java declaring crypto asset trading impermissible. Using an interpretive phenomenological approach, this research conducted in-depth, semi-structured interviews with 13 Muslim millennial crypto investors across East Java. The qualitative data were coded to identify recurring themes in investor motivation, social influence, and behavioral strategies. The findings reveal that while profit is the universal long-term objective, FOMO frequently serves as the predominant socio-emotional trigger for initial market entry. Decisions among the informants are operationalized through three strategic patterns: buy-and-hold, active management (day, swing, and position trading), and risk diversification. Furthermore, informants internally justify their continued participation through subjective, contextual reflections on Islamic ethical values, namely khalifah, ihsan, maslahah, and falah. The primary methodological limitation is its geographic constraint to 13 informants in East Java, bounding its external generalizability. The findings should be framed as context-specific rather than representative of all Indonesian Muslims. Practically, it highlights the need for inclusive investment education that addresses behavioral vulnerabilities and integrates technical literacy with ethical dimensions. This study offers a phenomenological contribution by demonstrating that among the selected informants, young Muslims navigate the digital economy through subjective personal religious reasoning and behavioral adaptation, moving beyond a rigid binary halal-haram compliance to negotiate their investment actions.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】这项探索性的现象学研究旨在分析印度尼西亚东爪哇地区部分穆斯林千禧一代投资者如何应对“错失恐惧”（FOMO）带来的心理压力，并在参与波动较大的加密货币市场的同时调和自身的宗教信仰。尽管印度尼西亚乌莱玛委员会（MUI）及东爪哇伊斯兰大学（PWNU East Java）已正式宣布加密货币交易为非法行为，这些投资者仍坚持进行相关活动。研究采用解释性现象学方法，对东爪哇地区的13名穆斯林千禧一代加密货币投资者进行了深入的半结构化访谈。通过对收集到的定性数据进行编码分析，研究者发现了投资者动机、社会影响因素及行为策略中的共同主题。

研究结果表明，虽然盈利是所有投资者的长期目标，但“错失恐惧”往往是他们最初进入加密货币市场的主要社会情感驱动因素。受访者的投资决策主要基于三种策略：长期持有、主动管理（日内交易、波段交易及趋势交易）以及风险分散。此外，这些投资者通过从伊斯兰伦理价值观（如哈里发精神、善行、公共利益等）出发进行主观反思，为自己的持续投资行为寻找合理性依据。然而，该研究的局限性在于样本仅限于东爪哇地区的13名受访者，因此其结论的普遍性有限，不能代表所有印度尼西亚穆斯林。从实际应用角度...。

papers.title: Apakah Pertumbuhan Penjualan Mampu Berperan dalam Memoderasi Pengaruh Arus Kas Bebas dan Belanja Modal terhadap Kinerja Keuangan
papers.abstract: This study examines the effects of free cash flow and capital expenditure on financial performance, with sales growth as a moderating variable. Financial performance indicates a company’s ability to manage resources and achieve its objectives. The study focuses on Consumer Non-Cyclicals sector companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) during 2020–2024, using secondary data from annual financial reports. The population comprised 128 companies, of which 66 were selected through purposive sampling. Data were analyzed using panel data regression and Moderated Regression Analysis (MRA), supported by EViews 12. Model selection tests identified the Fixed Effect Model (FEM) as the most appropriate model. The findings reveal that free cash flow and capital expenditure significantly affect financial performance. Sales growth moderates the effect of free cash flow on financial performance but does not moderate the relationship between capital expenditure and financial performance. These findings imply that companies should optimize free cash flow management, investment decisions, and sales growth strategies to improve their financial performance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究探讨了自由现金流和资本支出对财务绩效的影响，同时以销售增长作为调节变量。财务绩效反映了公司管理资源及实现目标的能力。研究聚焦于2020年至2024年间在印度尼西亚证券交易所（IDX）上市的消费非周期性行业公司，数据来源于这些公司的年度财务报告。研究对象共计128家公司，其中66家通过目的性抽样方法被选入样本。数据分析采用了面板数据回归（Panel Data Regression）和调节回归分析（Moderated Regression Analysis, MRA），分析工具为EViews 12。模型选择测试表明固定效应模型（Fixed Effect Model, FEM）是最合适的模型。研究结果表明，自由现金流和资本支出对财务绩效具有显著影响；销售增长能够缓解自由现金流对财务绩效的负面影响，但无法调节资本支出与财务绩效之间的关系。这些发现提示企业应优化自由现金流管理、投资决策及销售增长策略，以提升自身的财务绩效。。研究方法：面板数据、固定效应、回归分析。

papers.title: Topology Optimization and Generative Design in Additive Manufacturing: A Systematic Review of Algorithms, Tools and Industrial Applications
papers.venue: Open Access Research Journal of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Additive manufacturing (AM) has increased the design space of engineering components, allowing the creation of geometries which are hard or even impossible to realise through conventional machining, casting and forming. The capacity has added to the curiosity surrounding generative design (GD) and topology optimisation (TO), which aim to enhance structural performance, minimise material consumption and investigate other design options. This review combines the technical compilation provided with the relevant scholarly literature on the relationship between TO, GD and AM. The review is organised around the reporting principles of PRISMA 2020 and focuses specifically on the review question, eligibility logic, organisation of the evidence, methodological limitations and research gaps. Literature suggests that density-based approaches like Solid Isotropic Material with Penalisation (SIMP), level-set methods and evolutionary techniques continue to be important TO approaches, and GD is a broader requirements-driven approach which can involve optimisation, simulation, materials selection, and manufacturing constraints. The key result here is that having the best solution in the world of computation does not guarantee the best solution in the world of manufacturing, economy and reliability. All of these, such as overhangs, support structure, build orientation, enclosed voids, minimum feature size, anisotropy, residual stress, thermal distortion, surface finish, post-processing and cost, need to be taken into consideration in the design process. Applications in the aerospace, automotive and lightweight cellular structures sectors show promising potential, but benefits have only been reported in the context of specific applications. The next step in research should focus on coupled design–process optimisation, multi-physics modelling, uncertainty quantification, explainable artificial intelligence, experimental validation and closed-loop digital manufacturing. The synthesis is also embedded in the setting of an industrial economy, where knowledge and skills about the processes, their parameters and constraints determine what can be practically achieved, and in which limited use of AM and simulation tools is prevalent. The review finds that the maturity of TO and GD should be assessed based on the quality of validated engineering outcomes and not just on the geometric complexity or weight reduction alone.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】增材制造（AM）显著扩展了工程部件的设计可能性，使得那些通过传统机械加工、铸造和成型方法难以实现或根本无法实现的几何形状成为可能。这一技术进步进一步激发了人们对生成设计（GD）和拓扑优化（TO）的兴趣，这两种方法旨在提升结构性能、减少材料消耗并探索其他设计方案。本文综合了相关学术文献中的技术内容，探讨了TO、GD与AM之间的相互关系。综述遵循PRISMA 2020的报告准则，重点关注了研究问题的设定、证据的组织方式、方法论的局限性以及研究领域的空白。研究表明，基于密度的方法（如Solid Isotropic Material with Penalisation (SIMP)）、水平集方法和进化算法依然是重要的拓扑优化工具；而生成设计则是一种更为全面的、以需求为导向的设计方法，涵盖了优化、仿真、材料选择和制造约束等多个方面。然而，即使在计算领域找到了最优解，也不一定能保证在实际制造、经济性和可靠性方面达到最佳效果。在设计过程中，必须充分考虑诸如悬挑结构、支撑结构、构建方向、封闭空腔、最小特征尺寸、各向异性、残余应力、热变形、表面质量、后处理以及成本等因素。增材制造在航空航天、汽车制...。研究方法：数值模拟、实验方法。

papers.title: AI-Augmented Peer Review by Orthogonal Constraint: A Retrospective Case Study of Mathematical, Concordance, Chemical, and Meta-Review
papers.abstract:
The increasing use of artificial intelligence in scientific writing and mathematical formalization creates a corresponding need for review methods capable of validating rapidly generated, multidisciplinary technical work. We present and retrospectively evaluate an AI-augmented peer-review architecture in which distinct review stages are assigned orthogonal objectives: mathematical correctness, concordance with an established formal framework, chemical admissibility of molecular claims, targeted verification of revisions, and final meta-review. The method is examined through the development of The Chrysene Formalism Revisited: A Twelve-Axiom Foundation for Molecular Characterization, Tensorial Noncommutative Geometry, and Operator Response, a manuscript whose mathematical development is externally constrained by a molecular reference structure.
The complete review trajectory was reconstructed as a coded revision ledger. Sixty-four review/process actions were identified, of which 63 were manuscript-directed. Twenty-two revisions (34.9%) were classified as major, 20 (31.7%) as structural, and 59 (93.7%) were fully adopted. Forty-eight actions (76.2%) were explicitly verified in a subsequent review cycle, increasing to 55 (87.3%) when indirect later verification was included. The review disciplines generated markedly different correction profiles. Mathematics produced 35 of the 63 manuscript-directed actions and accounted for all coded proof/analytic repairs and theorem-strength corrections. Concordance generated nine actions, all of which were major and structural, including every action classified as structural restoration. Chemistry generated eight actions concentrated primarily in molecular qualification and nomenclature.
The pivotal event was the failure of a mathematically improved manuscript to pass concordance review, requiring substantial reconstruction before renewed chemistry and mathematics review. The case therefore suggests that the value of AI augmentation may lie not simply in increasing review volume, but in separating validation objectives, preserving reviewer disagreement as diagnostic information, distinguishing criticism from revision and verification, and maintaining an auditable record of manuscript development. Because this is a single retrospective case study without a conventional peer-review control group, the results do not establish the superiority of AI-augmented review. They instead provide a reproducible framework for prospective evaluation across future manuscripts.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】人工智能在科学写作和数学形式化中的日益广泛应用，催生了对能够快速验证多学科技术成果的评审方法的需求。我们提出了一种基于人工智能的同行评审架构，并对其进行了回顾性评估。该架构为不同的评审阶段设定了明确的目标：数学正确性、与既定形式框架的一致性、分子论点的化学合理性、对修订内容的针对性验证，以及最终的元评审。这一方法通过《Chrysene形式主义再探：分子表征、张量非交换几何与算子响应的十二公理基础》（The Chrysene Formalism Revisited: A Twelve-Axiom Foundation for Molecular Characterization, Tensorial Noncommutative Geometry, and Operator Response）这一手稿的编写过程得到了验证。该手稿的数学内容受到分子参考结构的严格约束。

整个评审过程被记录为编码修订日志，共识别出64项评审/处理动作，其中63项与手稿内容直接相关。22项修订（占34.9%）被归类为重大修改，20项（占31.7%）为结构性调整，59项（占93.7%）被完全采纳。在后续的...。

papers.title: From a Hierarchy of Stochastic Differential Equations to a Hierarchy of Generalized Beta Distributions
papers.abstract: We introduce a mean-reverting stochastic differential equation with a three-component stochastic term and show that it generates a hierarchy of steady-state (stationary) distributions. At the top level, the hierarchy is described by a modified-Beta distribution, while one- and two-parameter reductions produce compact-support, power-law-tailed, and exponential-type limiting families within a single stochastic framework.   We then construct two generalized extensions of this hierarchy. In the first, the power transformation is applied directly at the level of the stochastic differential equation; in the second, the same transformation is applied only after the stationary modified-Beta hierarchy has been obtained. While these two procedures agree on important lower branches and limiting cases they generally differ at the top level. The generalized hierarchy is therefore not unique: nonlinear transformation and stationary-state reduction do not commute.   For both routes, we derive the probability density and cumulative distribution functions, express their parameters in terms of the underlying stochastic dynamics, clarify the relations among their limiting cases, and compare the resulting families with the traditional Generalized Beta framework.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种具有三组分随机项的均值回归随机微分方程，并证明了该方程能够生成一系列稳态（静止）分布。在最高层次上，这些分布由修正的Beta分布来描述；而通过参数简化（一参数和两参数简化），可以在单一随机框架内得到具有紧支撑、幂律尾部和指数型分布特征的极限分布族。随后，我们构建了这一分布结构的两种广义扩展形式：在第一种扩展中，直接在随机微分方程的层面应用幂变换；在第二种扩展中，仅在获得稳态修正Beta分布结构之后才进行幂变换。尽管这两种方法在某些较低层次和极限情况下的结果一致，但在最高层次上存在差异。因此，这种广义分布结构并非唯一：非线性变换与稳态简化过程是不可交换的。对于这两种方法，我们都推导出了概率密度函数和累积分布函数，将其参数表示为潜在随机动态的函数，并阐明了它们在不同极限情况下之间的关系，并将所得到的分布族与传统的广义Beta分布框架进行了比较。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Risk-minimizing GUE-implementations of truthful reporting in a Dynamic Social Choice Problem
papers.abstract: The Guaranteed Utility Mechanism (GUM) was introduced to implement efficiency in Guaranteed Utility Equilibrium (GUE) in dynamic social choice problems. We show that this mechanism also has a previously unknown connection to risk minimization. Fixing an efficient decision policy, we study variance-minimizing budget-balanced transfer rules in the class of GUE-implementations of truthful reporting. A symmetrized version of GUM (sym-GUM) minimizes the sum of the agents' utility variances under truthful reporting when there is no public state. When a public state is present, a slight modification of this rule yields the minimizer for the same objective. Sym-GUM, however, does not minimize transfer risk. The minimizer for that problem is instead the symmetrized version of a closely related GUM-like transfer rule. In both problems, the minimizing truthful total transfers are unique up to agent-specific constants summing to zero and events of probability zero.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】保证效用机制（GUM）被引入用于在动态社会选择问题中实现保证效用均衡（GUE）的效率。我们发现该机制与风险最小化之间存在一种此前未被发现的关联。在确定了一个高效决策政策后，我们研究了在真实报告条件下、属于GUE实现类别中的方差最小化预算平衡转移规则。当不存在公共状态时，对称化版本的GUM（sym-GUM）能够在真实报告情况下最小化代理人效用方差的总和；而当存在公共状态时，对这一规则进行轻微修改即可得到实现相同目标的最优解。然而，sym-GUM并不能最小化转移风险；该问题的最优解实际上是另一种与GUM类似的转移规则的对称化版本。在这两种情况下，实现效用总和最小化的真实转移方案是唯一的，除非存在代理人特定的常数项（其总和为零）以及概率为零的事件。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: SOTA: Stock Options Trading Agents Guided by Option-Implied Return Distributions
papers.abstract: As option markets grow and AI advances, agentic systems for option trading are gaining increasing attention. Language-model-based agents can reason over contextual information such as news, but option trading presents a particularly challenging decision problem: a single stock can have thousands of contracts, and the agent must decide both which contracts to trade and how to combine them. Existing approaches often sidestep this complexity by restricting the policy to a fixed strategy structure, such as a straddle, limiting their ability to switch strategies as market conditions change. We present SOTA (Stock Options Trading Agents), an agentic trading framework for structured option-strategy selection. SOTA abstracts the large option universe into strategy-level decisions while deterministic resolvers handle portfolio implementation. We develop SOTA by post-training Qwen3.8-27B with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. SOTA is evaluated on options on nine large-cap U.S. equities and SPY against rule-based and machine-learning strategy selectors in the same trading environment. Over a six-month out-of-sample period, SOTA earns an 18.3% total return with a Sharpe ratio of 1.60 and a maximum drawdown of 8.96%. We also document an asymmetric role of news: news improves frontier-teacher trajectories, but retaining news during reinforcement learning reduces out-of-sample return from 18.3% to -2.7%.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】随着期权市场的发展和人工智能技术的进步，用于期权交易的智能代理系统越来越受到关注。基于语言模型的代理能够处理新闻等情境信息，但期权交易面临一个尤为复杂的决策问题：单只股票可能涉及数千份合约，代理需要同时决定交易哪些合约以及如何组合这些合约。现有方法通常通过将策略限制在固定的结构（如跨式策略）来规避这种复杂性，这限制了代理在市场条件变化时切换策略的能力。我们提出了SOTA（Stock Options Trading Agents），这是一个用于选择结构化期权策略的智能交易框架。SOTA将庞大的期权组合抽象为策略层面的决策，而确定性求解器则负责投资组合的实际执行。我们通过对Qwen3.8-27B模型进行监督微调并随后进行强化学习来开发SOTA。在相同的交易环境中，我们将SOTA与基于规则和机器学习的策略选择器进行了对比测试，测试对象为九只美国大盘股和SPY指数期权。在六个月的样本外测试期间，SOTA的总回报率为18.3%，夏普比为1.60，最大回撤率为8.96%。我们还发现新闻具有非对称的影响：新闻能够改善代理的学习轨迹，但在强化学习过程中保留新闻信息会导致样本外回报率从18.3%降...。

papers.title: The addicted predator-prey model: How opioid use disorder shapes productivity and growth-cycle dynamics
papers.abstract: This paper extends Goodwin's (1967) predator-prey growth-cycle model to incorporate the negative impact of Opioid Use Disorder (OUD) on labor productivity. Using U.S. state-level data for 1998--2019, we first document that deteriorations in the labor share are followed by rising drug-induced mortality. We then build this link into the model through a novel discrete-choice mechanism in which the probability of OUD decreases with the wage share, so when real wages fail to keep pace with productivity growth, opioid use rises. This behavioral health channel feeds back into the economy through a productivity damage function. Applying the existence part of the Andronov-Hopf bifurcation theorem, we show that the resulting three-dimensional nonlinear system admits a limit cycle, as confirmed by our numerical simulations. Along the cycle, rising OUD paradoxically raises the employment rate, as falling productivity requires more labor per unit of output; across steady states, however, higher OUD prevalence is associated with a lower employment rate, consistent with evidence that opioid use disorder reduces labor force participation. Moreover, our numerical experiments show that OUD sensitivity to income widens fluctuations, while productivity sensitivity to OUD counterintuitively compresses them through a self-correcting feedback that speeds the recovery of the wage share. Policies that weaken the link between income and OUD, such as stronger social safety nets, stabilize the resulting dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文扩展了Goodwin（1967年）提出的捕食者-猎物生长周期模型，以纳入阿片类药物使用障碍（OUD）对劳动生产率的负面影响。利用1998至2019年美国各州的数据，我们首先发现劳动份额的下降伴随着药物相关死亡率的上升。随后，我们通过一种新的离散选择机制将这一关联纳入模型：在该机制中，阿片类药物使用障碍的发生概率会随着工资份额的降低而降低；当实际工资增长未能跟上生产率的增长时，阿片类药物的使用量便会增加。这种行为健康因素通过生产率损害函数对经济产生反馈作用。运用Andronov-Hopf分岔定理的存在性证明，我们证明了该三维非线性系统存在一个极限环，这一结论也得到了数值模拟的验证。在该极限环内，阿片类药物使用障碍的加剧反而会提高就业率，因为生产率的下降意味着每单位产出需要更多的劳动力；然而在各个稳态下，较高的阿片类药物使用障碍发生率与较低的就业率相关，这与阿片类药物使用障碍会降低劳动力参与度的证据一致。此外，数值实验表明，阿片类药物使用障碍对收入的敏感性会加剧波动，而生产率对阿片类药物使用障碍的敏感性则会通过自我修正的反馈机制抑制波动，从而加快工资份额的恢复。加强社会保障等削弱...。研究方法：数值模拟、实验方法。
